region_scope: Americas, with Canada and Latin America preferred
purpose: Freeze a bounded construction-first review and new Fox Creek identity findings. This research packet makes no admissions, coordinates, normalized lifecycle observations, capacities, workloads, participant roles, or imagery claims.

baseline.head: 47327912d467e2755e6201feed5d8224c4b5857a
baseline.identity_review: All 173 selected feature properties, names and physical_site_stable_key values were read. Fox Creek/Opal, Hawesville and Los Teros have no selected name/key match. Fox Creek DOES have an older unselected stable identity and a prior explicit hold; these are preserved below.
baseline.full_geometry_review: The complete 173-feature GeoJSON was loaded and its exact body hash independently checked. No proposed point or boundary is produced, so candidate-to-baseline full-shape intersection checks are not applicable; no geometry-dedup pass is claimed.

rights_and_access.raw_captures_scope: Response bodies are temporary local audit material only. No complete source pages, maps, imagery, or third-party geometry are embedded or redistributed in this packet.
rights_and_access.reuse_basis: Compact factual research summaries and short anchors with attribution. No open license is asserted for Bitdeer, ATCO, Kiwetinohk, AUC or Alberta material.
rights_and_access.crs_scope: ATCO map 1 states NAD 1983 UTM Zone 11N. Alberta's rejected general project marker declares EPSG:4326. Neither is used to synthesize a campus locator.
rights_and_access.accuracy_semantics: Unknown. No position, survey accuracy, footprint, or campus boundary is claimed.

decisions.candidate: Bitdeer Fox Creek Alberta campus / former Kiwetinohk Opal power project

date_review.owner_article_scope: Owner describes groundbreaking of an integrated energy and computing facility. The owner corporate article displays June 1; the older IR/distributor announcement is dated June 2. Neither date is normalized into a newly accepted observation.

later_authoritative_context.scope: Prior frozen review identifies June work as the power-plant groundbreaking, with data-center design underway. The prior raw capture is referenced, not claimed rehashed in this pass.

date_review.current_owner_site: Undated campus page gives Q2 2026 construction-start and future Q4 2027 energization. This broad current timeline cannot backdate component-specific data-center physical work.
date_review.successor_caveat: No completion assertion is made. The unresolved problem is physical scope, not a demonstrated completion.

new_identity_facts: Kiwetinohk's February 4, 2025 release reports sale of the Opal project and its associated assets, contracts, leases and permits to Bitdeer.
AUC Approval 29843-D02-2025 dated March 12, 2025 transfers the Opal power-plant approval to BitDeer Energy Inc effective February 19, 2025.
AUC legal description is legal subdivisions 5, 6, 11 and 12 of section 21, township 62, range 19, west of the Fifth Meridian. It is a power-plant legal-area description, not a data-center point.
ATCO's July 2023 map 1 labels DML210060 and adjacent DML220014 near the customer's proposed Gemini 1008S substation. These disposition identifiers are useful future primary land-record leads only.

The older Opal newsletter explains the planned lease expansion from approximately 10 to 18 acres. It does not supply the promised layout in the captured one-page file and does not establish modern data-center construction.

The owner campus page and June article associate the Fox Creek computing facility with the acquired Kiwetinohk site. This supports continuity of identity, not a proof that power-plant work was data-center work.
locator_rejections: The Alberta major-projects page explicitly says its map location is not exact. Its coordinate is rejected and intentionally not reproduced here.
Do not substitute a town point, quarter-section/LSD center, a substation point, or the entire original generation-plant extent for exact data-center campus geometry.
ATCO's PDF is a transmission-project map with third-party cadastral/imagery credits and a property notice. No raster geocoding, polygon tracing, or redistribution was undertaken.
The official AER public map directory exposed exact disposition-service URLs, but two layer metadata routes were unsafe/non-retryable and were stopped before any feature query.
An independently indexed ArcGIS DIDs copy lacks verified authoritative ownership in this pass. It was not queried or used as a replacement.
decisions.campus_counting_guardrail: One inherited campus key only if future evidence closes. No separate power-plant campus, mining phase, AI phase, or substation site is created.
decisions.next_required_evidence: A genuinely new authoritative physical-work observation on the data-center component within May 22–August 20, followed by exact source-bound public geometry and a justified reuse basis. No further locator chase is justified merely to reclassify the already-held generation groundbreaking.

web_reader_discovery_only.finding: The same-period issuer narrative says construction is expected to commence in 2026 subject to planning and permitting. This materially limits the presentation category.

decisions.raw_capture_caveat: Both temporary raw files contain HTTP 403 responses, not the filings. No selected primary evidence binding is created from them.
decisions.next_required_evidence: Unambiguous in-window actual physical-work statement for the named Hawesville campus and an independently reusable exact locator. No future construction schedule is selected.

discovery_only.finding: Government visit is dated April 14, outside the fixed window.

screened_out_without_admission.reason: Current issuer reporting describes transition to active customer deployment and initial billing. No independently unfinished qualifying build scope was resolved; no capacity or fresh construction is inferred.
